description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1839/40 of 04.12.2013 in the Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520202
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the amendment of a land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about a specific parcel of land (No. 263 of Block 06) with cadastral map references, location details, and modifications to land title particulars regarding servitude rights and encumbrances. The document is published in "PART III - LANDS" and is issued by the Commissioner of Title Settlement from the Land Title Settlement Department, making it clearly focused on land and property-related matters.
